ex: You ate the last cookie, didn't you? Busted!
exzh: 你吃了最後一塊餅乾對吧?被抓包了!
note: 抓到人做壞事時喊;也可指被警察逮

ex: He has a solid alibi — he was at work all night.
exzh: 他有可靠的不在場證明——他整晚都在上班。
note: 警匪劇必出;也可指藉口

ex: You can't search my house without a warrant.
exzh: 沒有搜索票你不能搜我家。
note: 常見 search warrant(搜索票)

ex: Get me a blood test, stat!
exzh: 馬上給我驗血!
note: 醫療劇用語,源自拉丁文 statim

ex: Relax, rookie. Everyone messes up on day one.
exzh: 放輕鬆,菜鳥。大家第一天都會出錯。
note: 警察、運動員新人常用

ex: Nobody likes a snitch, so keep your mouth shut.
exzh: 沒人喜歡告密的人,所以閉上你的嘴。
note: 名詞動詞都可;snitch on sb 告發某人

ex: Shots fired! I need backup right now!
exzh: 有人開槍!我現在需要支援!
note: 警匪劇:call for backup 呼叫支援

ex: That's payback for what you did to me last week.
exzh: 這是報復你上週對我做的事。
note: Payback time! 復仇的時候到了

ex: Police! Freeze! Hands where I can see them!
exzh: 警察!不准動!手放在我看得到的地方!
note: 警察喊話;不是冷凍的意思

ex: Yikes, that haircut did not go well.
exzh: 哎呀,這髮型剪壞了。
note: 看到尷尬或可怕的事的反應

ex: Stop staring at her, you creep.
exzh: 別再盯著她看了,你這個變態。
note: creepy 令人毛骨悚然

ex: He took my parking spot. What a jerk!
exzh: 他搶了我的車位。真是個混蛋!
note: 比 asshole 溫和,電視上很常聽

ex: The robbers are holding three people hostage.
exzh: 搶匪挾持了三個人當人質。
note: hold sb hostage 挾持某人

ex: I didn't do it! This whole thing is a setup!
exzh: 不是我做的!這整件事是個圈套!
note: 動詞片語 set sb up 陷害某人

ex: The season ended on a huge cliffhanger.
exzh: 這一季在超大懸念中結束。
note: 影集季末吊胃口的結局

ex: Go talk to the boss. Don't worry, I've got your back.
exzh: 去找老闆談。別擔心,我挺你。
note: 友情、搭檔戲必出

en: you've got to be kidding me
ex: The flight's canceled again? You've got to be kidding me.
exzh: 班機又取消了?你在開玩笑吧。
note: 不敢置信又惱火;常說成 gotta

ex: You won the lottery? Get out of here!
exzh: 你中樂透了?不會吧!
note: 驚喜時=no way,不是叫人滾

ex: Thanks for covering my shift. I owe you one.
exzh: 謝謝你幫我代班。我欠你一次。
note: 被幫忙後的感謝,承諾回報

ex: Cut it out, you two! I'm trying to work.
exzh: 你們兩個夠了!我在工作。
note: 叫人停止煩人的行為

ex: You're smiling way too much. Okay, spill it.
exzh: 你笑得太誇張了。好啦,快說。
note: 催人講八卦或秘密;spill the beans

ex: You're dating him? Over my dead body!
exzh: 你要跟他交往?除非我死了!
note: 強烈反對,父母角色常說

ex: Loser buys dinner? You're on.
exzh: 輸的請吃晚餐?一言為定。
note: 接受挑戰或賭注

ex: Knock it off! You're going to break something.
exzh: 住手!你會把東西弄壞。
note: 比 cut it out 更不耐煩

ex: You don't want any pizza? Suit yourself.
exzh: 你不要披薩?隨便你。
note: 對方不聽勸時,帶點不爽

ex: Not so fast — you still owe me twenty bucks.
exzh: 慢著——你還欠我二十塊。
note: 阻止對方離開或下定論

ex: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone. My lips are sealed.
exzh: 別擔心,我不會告訴任何人。我會守口如瓶。
note: 保證保密

ex: Keep it down, guys. The baby's sleeping.
exzh: 大家小聲一點。寶寶在睡覺。
note: 叫人降低音量

ex: You saved me, I saved you. Now we're even.
exzh: 你救了我,我救了你。現在扯平了。
note: 誰也不欠誰

ex: He says he was sick all week? I'm not buying it.
exzh: 他說他病了一整週?我才不信。
note: buy 在此=相信;識破藉口

ex: Back off! This has nothing to do with you.
exzh: 退後!這跟你無關。
note: 叫人別逼近或別干涉

ex: I'll bring her home safe. You have my word.
exzh: 我會把她平安帶回家。我向你保證。
note: 鄭重承諾;I give you my word 同義

ex: I had to pick someone else. No hard feelings?
exzh: 我得選別人。你別往心裡去好嗎?
note: 拒絕或競爭後表示沒有惡意

ex: I'm leaving early. If the boss asks, cover for me.
exzh: 我要早退。老闆問的話幫我掩護。
note: 請人替你圓謊或代班

ex: Don't play dumb. I know you read my messages.
exzh: 別裝傻。我知道你看了我的訊息。
note: 明明知道卻假裝不知

ex: The cops are looking for us. We need to lay low for a while.
exzh: 警察在找我們。我們得避一陣子風頭。
note: 犯罪片常見;避免被注意

ex: Please don't make a scene in the restaurant.
exzh: 拜託別在餐廳大吵大鬧。
note: 在公共場所失控

ex: You have a better plan? Okay, I'm all ears.
exzh: 你有更好的計畫?好啊,我洗耳恭聽。
note: 有時帶挑釁、不相信的語氣

ex: You want me to do your homework? Nice try.
exzh: 要我幫你寫作業?想得美。
note: 識破對方的小把戲

ex: You think you can beat me? Bring it on!
exzh: 你覺得你贏得了我?放馬過來!
note: 接受挑戰,充滿自信

ex: Hey, can you come here? We need to talk.
exzh: 嘿,你可以過來嗎?我們得談談。
note: 通常是壞消息或要分手的前奏

en: It's not what it looks like.
ex: Wait, honey! It's not what it looks like.
exzh: 等等,親愛的!不是你想的那樣。
note: 被撞見尷尬場面的經典辯解

ex: You're going to tell Mom? Don't you dare.
exzh: 你要跟媽說?你敢!
note: 嚴厲警告;也可 Don't you dare + V

ex: Why are you so quiet in there? What are you up to?
exzh: 你在裡面怎麼這麼安靜?你在搞什麼鬼?
note: 懷疑時用;平常也可=最近在忙啥

ex: Relax, he won't call the police. He's bluffing.
exzh: 放輕鬆,他不會報警的。他在虛張聲勢。
note: call sb's bluff 叫對方攤牌

ex: This party is boring. Let's get out of here.
exzh: 這派對好無聊。我們走吧。
note: 逃跑或想換地方時都可用

ex: Okay, before you get mad — I can explain.
exzh: 好,在你生氣之前——我可以解釋。
note: 通常是做錯事被抓到時說

en: You have the right to remain silent.
ex: You're under arrest. You have the right to remain silent.
exzh: 你被捕了。你有權保持沉默。
note: 美國逮捕時的米蘭達警告開頭

ex: His heart rate is dropping. We're losing him!
exzh: 他的心跳在下降。他快不行了!
note: 醫療劇急救場面必出

en: Don't you walk away from me.
ex: I'm not done talking! Don't you walk away from me.
exzh: 我還沒說完!不准給我走掉。
note: 吵架時對方轉身離開

ex: You may have won today, but this isn't over.
exzh: 你今天也許贏了,但這事還沒完。
note: 反派或輸家撂狠話

ex: I think we should break up. It's not you, it's me.
exzh: 我想我們該分手了。不是你的問題,是我。
note: 老套分手台詞,常被拿來嘲諷

en: I didn't sign up for this.
ex: Wait, we have to climb that? I didn't sign up for this.
exzh: 等等,我們要爬那個?我可沒答應這個。
note: 抱怨情況超出原本預期

ex: Thanks, officer. I'll take it from here.
exzh: 謝謝,警官。接下來交給我。
note: 接手任務或情況

en: I was going to tell you.
ex: You're moving to Chicago? — I was going to tell you. I swear.
exzh: 你要搬去芝加哥?——我本來要跟你說的,我發誓。
note: 秘密被發現後的辯解

ex: Who else knows about this? Nobody can find out.
exzh: 還有誰知道這件事?不能讓任何人發現。
note: 秘密、陰謀劇情常見

en: You scared me half to death.
ex: Don't sneak up on me like that! You scared me half to death.
exzh: 別那樣偷偷靠近我!你嚇死我了。
note: 誇張說法;也說 scared me to death

ex: Oh, sorry. Am I interrupting something?
exzh: 喔,抱歉。我打擾到你們了嗎?
note: 撞見兩人獨處,常帶曖昧暗示

ex: Slow down. You're not making any sense.
exzh: 慢慢講。你說的我聽不懂。
note: 對方慌亂、語無倫次時

ex: Where were you last night? I called you five times.
exzh: 你昨晚在哪?我打給你五次。
note: 警察問案或伴侶質問都常見

ex: She waved her wand and the candles lit up.
exzh: 她揮了一下魔杖,蠟燭就亮了。
note: magic wand 也比喻萬靈丹

ex: The witch cast a spell on the whole village.
exzh: 女巫對整個村子施了咒。
note: cast a spell on sb;動詞固定用 cast

ex: Drink this potion and you'll be invisible for an hour.
exzh: 喝下這瓶藥水,你會隱形一小時。
note: love potion 愛情魔藥

ex: Only true courage can lift the curse.
exzh: 只有真正的勇氣能解除詛咒。
note: lift/break a curse 解咒;也可=罵髒話

ex: He put a hex on his rival's broom.
exzh: 他對對手的掃帚下了惡咒。
note: 比 curse 輕,偏惡作劇

ex: He hid under a dark cloak and slipped past the guards.
exzh: 他躲在黑斗篷下,溜過守衛。
note: cloak-and-dagger 諜報、鬼祟的

ex: If you could choose, would you want flight or invisibility?
exzh: 如果能選,你想要飛行還是隱形?
note: 形容詞 invisible

ex: The old prophecy said a child would save the kingdom.
exzh: 古老的預言說一個孩子會拯救王國。
note: 動詞 prophesy;發音不同(-sy/-cy)

ex: The old wizard lived alone in a tower.
exzh: 老巫師獨自住在一座塔裡。
note: 口語也指高手:a computer wizard

ex: In the story, the healer is accused of witchcraft.
exzh: 故事裡,那個治療師被指控使用巫術。
note: witch 女巫;craft 技藝

ex: The prisoners were locked in a cold dungeon.
exzh: 囚犯被關在冰冷的地牢裡。
note: 遊戲 D&D 的 dungeon 即此

ex: She dipped her quill in ink and began to write.
exzh: 她把羽毛筆沾了墨水開始寫。
note: 也指豪豬的刺

ex: Something green was bubbling in the cauldron.
exzh: 大鍋裡有綠色的東西在冒泡。
note: 女巫煮魔藥的那種大鍋

ex: Don't go into the enchanted forest after dark.
exzh: 天黑後別進魔法森林。
note: 也可=著迷的、陶醉的

ex: The evil sorcerer wants to rule the world.
exzh: 邪惡的術士想統治世界。
note: 常帶黑暗色彩;女性 sorceress

ex: The boy became the blacksmith's apprentice.
exzh: 男孩成了鐵匠的學徒。
note: 現實中也用:實習學徒制

ex: He spent years studying the dark arts in secret.
exzh: 他秘密研究黑魔法多年。
note: 也戲稱見不得光的技巧

ex: The king banished his brother from the land.
exzh: 國王把他弟弟逐出國土。
note: 也可 banish a demon 驅魔

ex: She used an old chant to summon a spirit.
exzh: 她用古老的咒語召喚了一個靈。
note: 日常:被召見 be summoned

ex: Be careful — the shapeshifter could look like anyone.
exzh: 小心——變形者可以變成任何人的樣子。
note: 能變換外形的生物

ex: The ancient scroll held a map to the treasure.
exzh: 古老的卷軸上有通往寶藏的地圖。
note: 動詞=滑動螢幕

ex: She wore an amulet to protect her from evil.
exzh: 她戴著護身符來避邪。
note: 近義 charm, talisman

ex: The knights rode toward the dragon's lair.
exzh: 騎士們騎馬奔向龍的巢穴。
note: 也指反派的秘密基地

ex: Peace returned to the realm after the war.
exzh: 戰後國度恢復了和平。
note: 也指領域:the realm of science

ex: Four friends set out on a quest to find the lost crown.
exzh: 四個朋友踏上尋找失落王冠的旅程。
note: 遊戲裡的「任務」也叫 quest

ex: A goblin jumped out from behind the rocks.
exzh: 一隻哥布林從石頭後面跳出來。
note: 醜陋、狡猾的小怪物

ex: He drew his sword and stepped forward.
exzh: 他拔出劍往前一步。
note: w 不發音;draw a sword 拔劍

ex: A huge beast was guarding the gate.
exzh: 一頭巨大的野獸守著大門。
note: 口語:這人是猛獸=超強

ex: A single kiss was enough to break the spell.
exzh: 一個吻就足以解除魔咒。
note: 也比喻打破美好氣氛

ex: He's acting strange, like he's under a spell.
exzh: 他行為怪怪的,好像中了魔咒。
note: 也比喻被迷住

ex: It's bloody freezing out there!
exzh: 外面冷得要命!
note: 英式強調詞;美式:damn / freaking

ex: You got us tickets? Brilliant!
exzh: 你幫我們弄到票?太棒了!
note: 美式:awesome / great

ex: Thanks for the help, mate.
exzh: 謝啦,兄弟。
note: 美式:buddy / dude / man

ex: Blimey, look at the size of that dog!
exzh: 天哪,看那隻狗有多大!
note: 驚訝;美式:Wow / Holy cow

ex: That's rubbish — he'd never say that.
exzh: 胡說八道——他絕不會那樣說。
note: 美式:trash / garbage / nonsense

ex: Give that back, you little git!
exzh: 還給我,你這小混蛋!
note: 英式罵人;美式:jerk

ex: Do you reckon it'll rain tomorrow?
exzh: 你覺得明天會下雨嗎?
note: 美式:think / guess(美南也說)

ex: Do you fancy a cup of tea? I think he fancies you.
exzh: 要來杯茶嗎?我覺得他喜歡你。
note: 美式:want / have a crush on

ex: Sorry, where's the loo?
exzh: 不好意思,廁所在哪?
note: 美式:bathroom / restroom

ex: I've been walking all day. I'm knackered.
exzh: 我走了一整天。累死了。
note: 美式:exhausted / wiped out

ex: We lost in the final minute. I'm gutted.
exzh: 我們在最後一分鐘輸了。我好難過。
note: 美式:crushed / bummed

ex: Don't be cheeky with your teacher.
exzh: 別對老師沒大沒小。
note: 常帶可愛感;美式:sassy / smart-mouthed

ex: Don't worry about the tickets — it's all sorted.
exzh: 別擔心票的事——全搞定了。
note: 美式:taken care of / all set

ex: I'll ask my mum if I can stay over.
exzh: 我問我媽能不能在這過夜。
note: 美式:mom

ex: Is there anything good on the telly tonight?
exzh: 今晚電視有什麼好看的嗎?
note: 美式:TV

ex: Can you lend me ten quid until Friday?
exzh: 可以借我十英鎊到週五嗎?
note: 單複數同形;美式:bucks

ex: Here's your coffee. — Cheers, mate.
exzh: 你的咖啡。——謝啦,兄弟。
note: 英式多指謝謝/再見;美式:thanks

ex: Morning, Tom! Are you all right? — Yeah, not bad.
exzh: 早啊,湯姆!還好嗎?——嗯,還不錯。
note: 英式打招呼不是問出事;美式:How's it going?

ex: There's a long queue outside the bakery.
exzh: 麵包店外排了長長的隊。
note: 美式:line / wait in line

ex: Exams start at the end of term.
exzh: 考試在學期末開始。
note: 英式一年三學期;美式:semester

ex: I felt like a total prat when I fell over.
exzh: 我跌倒時覺得自己像個大白痴。
note: 較輕的罵人;美式:idiot / jerk

ex: Your new bike is wicked!
exzh: 你的新腳踏車超酷!
note: 本義邪惡;美式:awesome / sick

ex: Right, I'm off. See you tomorrow!
exzh: 好,我走囉。明天見!
note: 美式:I'm heading out / I'm out

ex: They were caught snogging behind the library.
exzh: 他們被抓到在圖書館後面親熱。
note: 美式:make out

ex: She was really chuffed with her exam results.
exzh: 她對考試成績超開心的。
note: 美式:thrilled / stoked

ex: You want to swim in the sea in winter? You're mental!
exzh: 你冬天要下海游泳?你瘋了!
note: 美式:crazy / nuts;也可=超熱鬧

ex: Right, you lot, back to your seats!
exzh: 好了,你們大家,回座位去!
note: 美式:you guys / y'all

ex: She shares a flat with two friends in London.
exzh: 她在倫敦和兩個朋友合租公寓。
note: 美式:apartment

ex: I'm going on holiday for a fortnight.
exzh: 我要去度假兩個禮拜。
note: 美式:two weeks

ex: Put on a jumper — it's cold in here.
exzh: 穿件毛衣——這裡很冷。
note: 美式:sweater;美式 jumper=背心裙

ex: Honestly, I didn't expect to like it this much.
exzh: 說真的，我沒想到會這麼喜歡。
note: 句首常當緩衝詞，不一定是要講真心話

ex: So basically, I fix the stuff nobody else wants to touch.
exzh: 簡單說，我就是修別人都不想碰的東西。
note: 常拿來開始解釋自己的工作

ex: I literally just got here five minutes ago.
exzh: 我真的五分鐘前才剛到。
note: 口語多當加強語氣，不一定是字面意思

ex: Anyway, enough about me. How's your week going?
exzh: 總之，不講我了。你這週過得怎樣？
note: 拉回話題或準備換話題的訊號

ex: I'm so tired of this rain. — Same.
exzh: 這雨下得我好煩。——我也是。
note: 單字回應表示有同感，比 me too 更隨性

ex: I'd rather drive than fly that short. — Fair.
exzh: 那麼近我寧可開車不搭飛機。——也是。
note: 單字回應，表示接受對方的觀點

ex: I'm kind of obsessed with this coffee place.
exzh: 我有點迷上這家咖啡店。
note: 口語「超愛」，不是負面的強迫症

ex: You should ask Jen. She's a total foodie.
exzh: 你該問 Jen，她是超級吃貨。
note: 問餐廳推薦時很好用

ex: We're just doing a staycation this year.
exzh: 我們今年就在家附近玩玩。
note: stay+vacation，不出遠門的假期

ex: Taipei is my hometown, but I lived in Tainan for years.
exzh: 台北是我家鄉，但我在台南住過好幾年。
note: 被問 where are you from 可接著講

ex: I mean, it's not bad, it's just really expensive.
exzh: 就是說，也不差啦，只是真的很貴。
note: 補充或修正前一句，常是緩衝

ex: It's one of those places, you know, where everyone knows everyone.
exzh: 那種地方你懂的，大家都互相認識。
note: 填充詞，不用回答它

ex: The movie was kind of slow at the start.
exzh: 那部電影開頭有點慢。
note: 口語常唸成 kinda，用來把話說軟

ex: To be fair, they were really busy that night.
exzh: 說句公道話，他們那晚真的很忙。
note: 幫人或事講好話、平衡批評時用

ex: I'm only on episode three, so no spoilers!
exzh: 我才看到第三集，不准劇透！
note: 聊影集必備，對方會笑著答應

ex: We should grab lunch sometime. — Oh, for sure.
exzh: 改天一起吃午餐吧。——喔，當然。
note: 隨口答應；美國人說改天常只是客套

ex: Not gonna lie, I was a little nervous.
exzh: 老實講，我有點緊張。
note: 簡訊寫作 ngl，後面接真心話

ex: I just don't like crowds. — Fair enough.
exzh: 我就是不喜歡人多。——也是啦。
note: 接受對方理由，不再爭論

ex: You think it's overrated? Yeah, I could see that.
exzh: 你覺得它被高估？嗯，我能理解。
note: 軟性同意，不一定完全認同

ex: It took me two hours to get here. — No kidding?
exzh: 我花兩小時才到這。——真的假的？
note: 語調上揚=驚訝；下降=「可不是嘛」

ex: You moved here without visiting first? That's wild.
exzh: 你沒來看過就搬來？太誇張了。
note: 年輕人常用的驚訝反應，正負面都可

ex: I finally ran my first half marathon. — Good for you!
exzh: 我終於跑完第一場半馬。——太棒了！
note: 語氣要真誠，冷淡說會像諷刺

ex: You know Kevin too? Small world!
exzh: 你也認識 Kevin？世界真小！
note: 發現共同朋友時的標準反應

ex: My flight got canceled twice. — Ugh, been there.
exzh: 我的班機被取消兩次。——唉，我也遇過。
note: 表示同感、拉近距離

ex: We're going camping this weekend. — Oh, sounds fun!
exzh: 我們這週末去露營。——喔，聽起來好好玩！
note: 回應別人的計畫，接著可問 where?

ex: I'm from Taiwan originally. How about you?
exzh: 我老家在台灣。那你呢？
note: 回答完把問題丟回去，對話才不會斷

ex: We should catch up over coffee sometime.
exzh: 改天喝咖啡聊聊近況吧。
note: 也指追進度：catch up on the show

ex: I'm not a big fan of spicy food, honestly.
exzh: 老實說，我不太喜歡辣的。
note: not a big fan of 是委婉的不喜歡

ex: That ramen place is my go-to spot after work.
exzh: 那家拉麵是我下班常去的店。
note: 問推薦：What's your go-to spot?

ex: It's a tiny hole-in-the-wall, but the food is amazing.
exzh: 那是間不起眼的小店，但東西超好吃。
note: 讚美語氣：小而隱密的好店

en: at the end of the day
ex: At the end of the day, it's just a job.
exzh: 說到底，那就只是份工作。
note: 做結論時用，不是指傍晚

ex: How's the new job? — So far so good.
exzh: 新工作怎麼樣？——目前還不錯。
note: 被問新環境時的萬用回答

ex: I feel like everyone here drives everywhere.
exzh: 我覺得這裡的人去哪都開車。
note: 美國人極常用，比 I think 軟

ex: I'd love to come. The thing is, I work Saturdays.
exzh: 我很想去。問題是我週六要上班。
note: 婉拒或說明難處前的鋪墊

ex: Rock climbing? Cool, what got you into it?
exzh: 攀岩？酷，你怎麼開始玩的？
note: 問興趣的最佳追問句型

en: So how long have you been there?
ex: I work at a hospital. — Oh nice. So how long have you been there?
exzh: 我在醫院工作。——不錯耶。那你在那多久了？
note: 聽到對方職業後的第一個追問

en: How do you like it so far?
ex: You just started last month? How do you like it so far?
exzh: 你上個月才開始？目前覺得怎樣？
note: 問新工作/新城市都可用

en: What does that look like day to day?
ex: Product manager, huh? What does that look like day to day?
exzh: 產品經理喔？那你平常都做些什麼？
note: 顯得真有興趣，比 what is that 好

ex: I went to Yosemite last weekend. — Oh yeah? How was it?
exzh: 我上週末去優勝美地。——是喔？怎樣？
note: Oh yeah? 上揚=「真的嗎」，鼓勵對方多講

en: That's so interesting. How did you get started?
ex: I make furniture on the side. — That's so interesting. How did you get started?
exzh: 我副業做家具。——好有趣，你怎麼開始的？
note: 稱讚+追問，最好用的接話公式

en: What do you do for fun?
ex: So when you're not working, what do you do for fun?
exzh: 那你不上班時喜歡做什麼？
note: 比問工作更輕鬆的開場

en: Got any plans for the holidays?
ex: Got any plans for the holidays? Or are you staying in town?
exzh: 假期有計畫嗎，還是留在這裡？
note: 11-12 月的標準閒聊開場

en: Are you watching anything good right now?
ex: Are you watching anything good right now? I need a new show.
exzh: 你最近在追什麼好劇嗎？我需要新的劇。
note: 聊劇的開場，可答 I just finished…

ex: Everyone's talking about that new sci-fi show. Have you seen it?
exzh: 大家都在聊那部新科幻劇，你看過嗎？
note: 沒看過可說 Not yet, is it good?

en: I haven't gotten to that episode yet.
ex: Wait, stop! I haven't gotten to that episode yet.
exzh: 等等，停！我還沒看到那一集。
note: 阻止劇透的實用句

en: So what brought you to the States?
ex: So what brought you to the States? Work or school?
exzh: 那你怎麼會來美國？工作還是讀書？
note: 答 Work, mostly. 再補一句細節即可

ex: I've never been to Taiwan. What's it like there?
exzh: 我沒去過台灣，那邊怎樣？
note: 準備一兩句食物/夜市的答案

en: I've been here about a year now.
ex: I've been here about a year now. Still figuring things out.
exzh: 我來這大約一年了，還在適應。
note: 回答 how long have you been here

en: Do you have any recommendations around here?
ex: I'm new to the area. Do you have any recommendations around here?
exzh: 我剛搬來，這附近有推薦的嗎？
note: 美國人很愛推薦，好開話題

en: You have to try the tacos there.
zh: 你一定要吃那裡的塔可
ex: Oh, you have to try the tacos there. They're unreal.
exzh: 喔，你一定要吃那家的塔可，超扯好吃。
note: you have to 是熱情推薦，非命令

en: Have you been anywhere fun lately?
ex: Have you been anywhere fun lately? I need travel ideas.
exzh: 你最近有去哪玩嗎？我需要旅遊點子。
note: 引出旅遊話題

ex: Big game Sunday. Who are you rooting for?
exzh: 週日有大比賽，你挺哪隊？
note: 不懂球就答 Whoever's winning!

en: Did you catch the game last night?
ex: Did you catch the game last night? That ending was crazy.
exzh: 你有看昨晚的比賽嗎？結尾太扯了。
note: catch=看到；沒看可說 No, who won?

en: I don't really follow sports, but I'm down to watch.
zh: 我不太看球，但可以陪看
ex: I don't really follow sports, but I'm down to watch. Just explain the rules.
exzh: 我不太看球，但可以一起看，教我規則就好。
note: 不懂球又想合群的萬用句

en: It's supposed to warm up this weekend.
ex: Hang in there. It's supposed to warm up this weekend.
exzh: 撐著點，這週末應該會回暖。
note: supposed to=預報說，聊天氣常用

en: Is it always this humid here?
ex: Is it always this humid here? I'm melting.
exzh: 這裡一直這麼濕嗎？我快融化了。
note: 新來者問天氣，當地人很愛回答

en: Your dog is adorable. What's his name?
ex: Oh my gosh, your dog is adorable. What's his name?
exzh: 天啊，你的狗好可愛，牠叫什麼？
note: 不確定性別用 What's their name?

ex: He's so fluffy! Can I pet him?
exzh: 牠好蓬鬆！我可以摸牠嗎？
note: 摸別人的狗前一定先問

ex: How old are your kids? Mine are six and nine.
exzh: 你小孩幾歲？我的六歲和九歲。
note: 家長間最常見的開場

en: I love your jacket. Where'd you get it?
ex: I love your jacket. Where'd you get it? — Thanks! Target, actually.
exzh: 你外套好好看，哪買的？——謝啦！其實是 Target。
note: 讚美東西不讚美身材；回 Thanks 即可

en: I'm not so sure about that.
ex: You think the Bay Area is cheaper now? Hmm, I'm not so sure about that.
exzh: 你覺得灣區現在比較便宜？嗯，我不太確定耶。
note: 委婉不同意，比 You're wrong 安全

en: Well, it was great chatting with you.
ex: Well, it was great chatting with you. Enjoy the rest of the party!
exzh: 好啦，很高興跟你聊，好好享受派對！
note: Well 開頭=要結束對話的禮貌訊號

en: I'm gonna go grab a drink. Want anything?
zh: 我去拿喝的，要幫你拿嗎
ex: I'm gonna go grab a drink. Want anything? — I'm good, thanks.
exzh: 我去拿個喝的，要幫你拿嗎？——不用，謝謝。
note: 派對中自然離開對話的好藉口

en: I'll let you get back to it.
ex: Anyway, I'll let you get back to it. See you around!
exzh: 總之，不打擾你了，再見！
note: 對方在忙時禮貌收尾

ex: Sorry, say that again? I missed the last part.
exzh: 抱歉，再說一次？我漏聽最後一段。
note: 沒聽清楚很正常，直接問不失禮

ex: Wait, what was that? You're moving to Denver?
exzh: 等等，你剛說什麼？你要搬去丹佛？
note: 沒聽清或很驚訝都可用

en: Sorry, it's a little loud in here.
ex: Sorry, it's a little loud in here. Did you say Boston or Austin?
exzh: 抱歉這裡有點吵，你是說波士頓還是奧斯汀？
note: 聽不清時給自己台階，再確認關鍵字

ex: Here's my number. Let's keep in touch.
exzh: 這是我的電話，保持聯絡喔。
note: 道別客套語，可順便交換 IG/電話

ex: You moved for the job? That makes total sense.
exzh: 你是為了工作搬來的？完全合理。
note: 表示理解對方的選擇，讓人舒服

ex: You guys are so cute. How did you two meet?
exzh: 你們好登對，你們怎麼認識的？
note: 對情侶/朋友的經典追問

ex: Gimme a sec, I'm almost done.
exzh: 給我一下，我快好了。
note: = give me;聽起來像 GIM-ee

ex: Turn left at the light. — Gotcha.
exzh: 紅綠燈左轉。——了解。
note: = got you;GAH-cha，也有「抓到你」意

ex: Hey, whatcha doing this weekend?
exzh: 嘿，你這週末要幹嘛？
note: = what are you;WAH-cha

ex: Didja see the email from HR?
exzh: 你有看到人資的信嗎？
note: = did you;DID-ja，d+y 黏成 j 音

ex: Wouldja mind holding the door?
exzh: 可以幫我扶一下門嗎？
note: = would you;WOOD-ja

ex: You coulda told me earlier!
exzh: 你本來可以早點跟我說的！
note: = could have;KOOD-uh，have 弱到消失

ex: I shoulda left an hour ago.
exzh: 我一小時前就該走了。
note: = should have;SHOOD-uh，常帶後悔

ex: I woulda come if I'd known.
exzh: 早知道我就會來。
note: = would have;WOOD-uh

ex: It's sorta like a burrito, but smaller.
exzh: 它有點像墨西哥捲餅，但比較小。
note: = sort of;SOR-duh，t 變輕彈音

ex: I'm outta here. See you tomorrow!
exzh: 我閃了，明天見！
note: = out of;OW-duh

ex: That's a lotta food for two people.
exzh: 兩個人吃這樣也太多了。
note: = lot of;LAH-duh

ex: I can't go 'cause I have work early.
exzh: 我不能去，因為我很早要上班。
note: = because;唸 kuz，be 整個消失

ex: C'mon, it'll be fun!
exzh: 來嘛，會很好玩的！
note: = come on;kuh-MON，語氣決定意思

ex: Nice seeing ya! Drive safe.
exzh: 很高興見到你！開車小心。
note: = you;弱讀成 yuh

ex: It's just, y'know, kind of a lot right now.
exzh: 就是，你懂的，最近事情有點多。
note: = you know;YNOH，填充詞不必回應

ex: Whaddaya want for dinner?
exzh: 你晚餐想吃什麼？
note: = what do you;WAH-duh-yuh

ex: I hafta pick up my kid at five.
exzh: 我五點要去接小孩。
note: = have to;HAF-tuh，v 變 f

ex: She hasta work late again tonight.
exzh: 她今晚又要加班。
note: = has to;HAS-tuh，非西語 hasta

ex: I'm just tryna get home before the traffic.
exzh: 我只是想在塞車前到家。
note: = trying to;TRY-nuh

ex: That ain't gonna work, man.
exzh: 那樣行不通啦。
note: = isn't/aren't/haven't;非正式勿寫

ex: I made cookies. Want some of 'em?
exzh: 我做了餅乾，要吃一些嗎？
note: = them;唸 um，th 消失

ex: I'll prolly just stay home tonight.
exzh: 我今晚大概就待在家。
note: = probably;PRAH-lee，中間 bab 吞掉

ex: I'mma head out. Text me later.
exzh: 我要先走了，晚點傳訊息給我。
note: = I'm going to;AI-muh

ex: Hey man, s'up? — Not much, you?
exzh: 嘿，怎樣？——沒什麼，你呢？
note: = what's up;回 Not much 即可

ex: Hey, how'zit going? — Pretty good, thanks.
exzh: 嘿，最近怎樣？——還不錯，謝謝。
note: = how is it going;HOW-zit

ex: Why dontcha just ask her?
exzh: 你為什麼不直接問她？
note: = don't you;DOHN-cha

ex: I betcha he forgets again.
exzh: 我打賭他又會忘記。
note: = bet you;BET-cha

ex: You oughta try that new Thai place.
exzh: 你應該去試試那家新泰式餐廳。
note: = ought to;AW-duh

ex: I useta live right down the street.
exzh: 我以前就住在這條街上。
note: = used to;YOOS-tuh，d 不發音

ex: Weren't we supposta meet at noon?
exzh: 我們不是應該中午碰面嗎？
note: = supposed to;suh-POHS-tuh

ex: I musta left my keys in the car.
exzh: 我一定是把鑰匙留在車上了。
note: = must have;MUS-tuh

ex: He mighta already left.
exzh: 他可能已經走了。
note: = might have;MY-duh

ex: I needa grab some gas first.
exzh: 我得先去加個油。
note: = need to;NEE-duh

ex: What're you talking 'bout?
exzh: 你在說什麼？
note: = about;唸 bowt，a 被吃掉

ex: Aight, I'll see you there.
exzh: 好，那邊見。
note: = alright;AYT，非常隨性

ex: C'mere, I wanna show you something.
exzh: 過來，我想給你看個東西。
note: = come here;kuh-MEER

ex: Whadja think of the movie?
exzh: 你覺得那部電影怎樣？
note: = what did you;WAH-ja

ex: Alright, see ya Monday!
exzh: 好，週一見！
note: = see you;SEE-yuh，最常見道別

ex: I'm Dan. — Nice to meetcha, Dan.
exzh: 我是 Dan。——很高興認識你，Dan。
note: = meet you;MEE-cha，t+y 變 ch

ex: Sorry I'm late, I hadda drop off a package.
exzh: 抱歉遲到，我得先去寄個包裹。
note: = had to;HAD-uh
